title: Machine group list scoping and vpnConnectedUsers wire details

prose.text: Machine group and VPN-connected-user API details beyond the read-only surface already described in [[zpa.machine-groups.api-surface]]. The machine-group model gaps, the signingCert versus enrollmentCert divergence and the summary endpoint are in that subject.

checks.do: Whether a Python machine group list for the Default microtenant (0) was overridden by the client's configured microtenantId.
Whether a vpnConnectedUsers read was expected to be microtenant-scoped, which the Go SDK does not do.

microtenant-default-zero.statement: The OpenAPI machine group list says microtenantId is 0 for the Default microtenant and null for Customer data microtenant. The Python list_machine_groups maps microtenant_id only when it is truthy, but the executor camel-cases ZPA query keys, so a caller's `microtenant_id` reaches the wire as `microtenantId` whether or not the module maps it. A falsy value is replaced by the client's configured microtenantId when one is set. The Go pagination struct omits microtenantId only when its pointer is nil.

expect.description: The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

microtenant-default-zero.conditions: Whether the server treats a missing microtenantId as the default or as the customer-data microtenant is stated only by the OpenAPI description. The Python half was restated because the executor camel-cases and back-fills microtenantId, so an integer 0 is not dropped as the earlier statement said.

np-client-no-microtenant-filter.statement: The Go np_client service passes an empty common.Filter to the paging helper in both GetAll and GetByName for vpnConnectedUsers, so neither function puts the service's microtenant ID in the filter, and the helper, which takes the client and the filter rather than the service, has no service to read it from. The Python NPNClientControllerAPI list_vpn_connected_users forwards query_params without the microtenant_id mapping that list_machine_groups performs, but Python scopes it anyway, because the executor camel-cases microtenant_id and falls back to the client's configured microtenantId.
